assumptions: The target role is server-only; client-only behavioral requirements such as REQ-DISCONNECT-005 and REQ-DISCONNECT-006 are exercised through codec wire-shape tests and assigned to the codec work package.

The generated headers include/mqtt/mqtt_types.h, include/mqtt/mqtt_codec.h, include/mqtt/mqtt_session.h, and include/mqtt/mqtt_net.h are produced by templates, are frozen at s5, and are consumed through contracts rather than owned by runtime modules.
The s6_owned source slots are the only files owned by modules; Makefile and README.md are frozen layout-template artifacts and are not module-owned.
Resource limits from the delivery constraints define the connection cap, output batch cap, and per-item byte cap for the network layer.

contracts.purpose: Expose the generated MQTT type declarations and per-message codec entry points to the session module.
Expose the server-side session API for connection, bytes, disconnect, and tick events.
Expose the network event source and caller-provided output batch interface to the application.

decisions.statement: Keep codec as pure wire translation, session as the protocol state machine, net as the I/O event source, and app as the composition root.
Generated headers are frozen at s5, but implementation contracts become ready when their owning module's work package completes, so contract ready_gate is task.
Runtime modules own only s6_owned source slots; generated headers are consumed through contracts and are not included in module file ownership.
Net emits connect, bytes, disconnect, and tick events; the application dispatches them into the session API, and session-produced output batches are transmitted by net.
Wire-shape and primitive validation requirements belong to codec; server lifecycle, session, and error-close requirements belong to session; transport requirements belong to net.
Makefile and README.md are produced by the layout template at s5 and are excluded from runtime module ownership.

modules.name: Codec
non_goals: Do not own sockets or network I/O.
Do not own session state or subscription routing.
Do not decide server behavior after reporting a decode error.
modules.purpose: Own wire-format type declarations, per-message codec entry points, and MQTT wire primitives.
responsibilities: Implement per-message encode/decode entry points for CONNACK, CONNECT, DISCONNECT, PINGREQ, PINGRESP, PUBLISH, SUBACK, SUBSCRIBE, UNSUBACK, and UNSUBSCRIBE.
Implement MQTT Variable Byte Integer, MQTT UTF-8 string, and big-endian integer wire primitives.
Enforce fixed-header flags, forbidden packet types, UTF-8 string validity, PUBLISH topic constraints, and requested-QoS wire constraints.

modules.name: Session
non_goals: Do not read or write sockets directly.
Do not implement wire encoding primitives.
Do not own the application event loop.
modules.purpose: Own the server-side protocol state machine: connection lifecycle, session state, subscriptions, keep-alive, and message forwarding.
responsibilities: Complete the CONNECT handshake and emit CONNACK with session-present and return-code rules.
Maintain per-client session state, clean-session lifecycle, subscriptions, and keep-alive timers.
Process SUBSCRIBE and UNSUBSCRIBE and emit SUBACK and UNSUBACK.
Route PUBLISH application messages to matching subscriptions with RETAIN=0.
Close connections on protocol violations, transient errors, and valid DISCONNECT.

modules.name: Network
non_goals: Do not implement protocol timers beyond delivering tick events.
modules.purpose: Own the ordered lossless byte-stream transport boundary and output batching for the server.
responsibilities: Track client connections up to max_connections and emit connect, bytes, disconnect, and tick events.
Provide the caller-owned output batch API with connection id, bytes, length, and close flags.
Enforce output batch and per-item resource limits.

modules.name: Server Application
non_goals: Do not own session state or codec internals.
modules.purpose: Compose the network event source with the session server API and run the server entry point.
responsibilities: Dispatch net connect, bytes, disconnect, and tick events to session handlers.
Flush session-produced output batches through the net output API and run the main loop.

acceptance.outcome: All ten per-message codec sources compile against the generated headers and pass the L1 codec reference tests, including Remaining Length and UTF-8 boundaries.

work_packages.goal: Implement all per-message encode/decode functions and MQTT wire primitives.
work_packages.title: MQTT wire codec implementation

acceptance.outcome: The session source implements the mqtt_session.h API and passes the L2 behavior tests, including malformed packet isolation and keep-alive behavior.

work_packages.goal: Implement the session API that drives connection, subscription, keep-alive, and forwarding behavior.
work_packages.title: Server session state machine

acceptance.outcome: The network source implements the mqtt_net.h event and output-batch API with the declared resource limits.

work_packages.goal: Implement the connection tracking, event source, and output batching declared in mqtt_net.h.
work_packages.title: Network event and output batch layer

acceptance.outcome: The application entry point wires net events to session handlers and flushes output batches.
